messages:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for Dedicated Capacity vNext. Goal: clear SLA targets + deterministic sizing/autoscale rules so Sales + Eng can agree. Need acceptance criteria and edge cases captured. Thoughts?

Ben Kline: +1. Start with provisional latency SLOs by model class. Suggest: small (<2B) p95 <= 150ms, medium (2B-20B) p95 <= 350ms, large (>20B) p95 <= 900ms. Assumes warm KV cache and usual batching.

Priya Singh: Those look like good anchors. Also include throughput sizing: tokens/sec per GPU (at 1k token seq) and concurrency slots per GPU. Sales wants a one-line calculator they can use in docs.

Mateo Rivera: For autoscale, we should define ramp/cooldown and a burst buffer. Proposal: cooldown = 120s, scale-step = +1 node, burst buffer = 10% headroom for 60s. Also min/max nodes in PRD.

Alice Chen: Edge cases to call out: cold starts (KV cache miss), very long sequences (>4096 tokens), fallback to quantized variants, and regional failover. Each needs an acceptance test.

Ben Kline: Sizing formula to include in PRD (simple):
```
required_gpus = ceil((qps * avg_tokens_per_request) / (tokens_per_sec_per_gpu * efficiency_factor))
```
Worked example: `ceil((100 qps * 128 tokens) / (20000 tps * 0.85))` => ~1 GPU.

Priya Singh: Add traffic shape buckets: steady, 90th spike, 99th spike. Define SLA measurement window (30d rolling). SLA breach trigger: p95 above target for 3 consecutive days or >3 dropped requests per 1000 in a 24h window.

Mateo Rivera: Autoscale fallback policy: if scale-up fails, route to hosted with clear cost/latency delta. Also require canary rollout (10% traffic) before full switch.

Alice Chen: Draft acceptance checklist (WIP):
- SLO table by model class included
- Sizing calc + 3 worked examples
- Autoscale policy + cooldown/burst behaviour defined
- Test plan: synthetic load, cold-cache, long-seq, canary
- Graceful degradation steps documented
Anything missing?

Ben Kline: Add cost guardrails: max cost-per-request threshold for Dedicated customers; if threshold exceeded auto-throttle or fallback to smaller model.

Priya Singh: Note customer ask: BankCorp requests 99.95% uptime + <200ms p95 on medium models. Flag as enterprise exception — will require reserved pool + stricter quant profiles and verification testing.

Alice Chen: @Ben can you draft the SLO table by EOD? @Priya please add the BankCorp note and contract implications. I'll start the PRD skeleton and include the sizing formula.

deploy-bot: Reminder: PRD template created at https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/dedicated-vnext (placeholder) :white_check_mark:

Mateo Rivera: I'll own the autoscale test harness next sprint and add it to eng-platform backlog.

Alice Chen: Thanks all. Action items: Ben -> SLO table; Priya -> customer notes & contracts; Mateo -> autoscale tests. Let's finalize acceptance criteria Tue 10am PT.
